mapper.select: SELECT id, title, status, details, due_date AS dueDate, due_date_undecided AS dueDateUndecided, auto_carry_over AS autoCarryOver, is_daily AS daily, daily_reset_date AS dailyResetDate, has_flag AS hasFlag, category_id AS categoryId, parent_id AS parentId, overdue_behavior AS overdueBehavior, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM todos WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todos ( title, status, details, due_date, due_date_undecided, auto_carry_over, is_daily, daily_reset_date, has_flag, category_id, parent_id, overdue_behavior, sort_order ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{status}, #{details}, #{dueDate}, #{dueDateUndecided}, #{autoCarryOver}, #{daily}, #{dailyResetDate}, #{hasFlag}, #{categoryId}, #{parentId}, #{overdueBehavior}, #{sortOrder} )
mapper.update: UPDATE todos SET title = #{title}, status = #{status}, details = #{details}, due_date = #{dueDate}, due_date_undecided = #{dueDateUndecided}, auto_carry_over = #{autoCarryOver}, is_daily = #{daily}, daily_reset_date = #{dailyResetDate}, has_flag = #{hasFlag}, category_id = #{categoryId}, parent_id = #{parentId}, overdue_behavior = #{overdueBehavior}, sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE todos SET status = 'INCOMPLETE', daily_reset_date = CURRENT_DATE WHERE is_daily = TRUE AND ( daily_reset_date IS NULL OR daily_reset_date < CURRENT_DATE )
